benefits.name: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Automatic Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status, including a 25% bonus on points earned on eligible stays, late checkout, premium internet, and room upgrades (subject to availability).
benefits.terms: 25% bonus on base points earned on eligible stays. Room upgrades and other Gold perks subject to availability.

benefits.name: 15 Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: 15 Elite Night Credits toward Marriott Bonvoy elite status each calendar year, stackable with nights earned from actual stays.

benefits.name: Anniversary Free Night Award
benefits.description: 1 Free Night Award, redeemable at a participating hotel with a redemption level at or under 35,000 Marriott Bonvoy points, issued each year on the card's account anniversary.
benefits.terms: Issued automatically each year on the account anniversary, not spend-based. Can be topped up with up to 25,000 additional personal points for a higher-category property. Certain hotels charge resort fees not covered by the award.

benefits.name: Spend-Based Free Night Award
benefits.description: An additional Free Night Award (redemption level at or under 35,000 Marriott Bonvoy points) after spending $60,000 on eligible purchases on the card in a calendar year.
benefits.terms: Requires $60,000 in eligible purchases in a calendar year. Can be topped up with up to 25,000 additional personal points for a higher-category property.

benefits.name: 7% Discount on Direct Bookings
benefits.description: A 7% discount on eligible standard room bookings made directly with Marriott through an eligible channel under the Amex Business Card Rate, for participating properties.
benefits.terms: Applies only to participating properties booked directly with Marriott under the Amex Business Card Rate.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Coverage for damage or theft on most rental cars when the rental is paid for with the card and the rental company's collision damage waiver is declined.

benefits.name: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen checked and carry-on bags on trips paid for with the card.

benefits.name: Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: 24/7 access to the Global Assist Hotline for medical, legal, financial, or other emergency coordination assistance when traveling more than 100 miles from home.
benefits.terms: Assistance and referral services; cardholder is responsible for the cost of any services rendered.

earningRates.terms: Eligible purchases at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels.
Wireless telephone services purchased directly from U.S. service providers.
